whyChain: Eighteen trace rows opened another row's conversation because the resolver selected the first prefix match.
The index stores a 60-character display task ID, while the source trace stores the full task ID.
The display abbreviation was reused as an identity key.
No exhaustive row-to-source bijection check exercised all 648 click targets.
The trace browser treated visible labels as persistent identity rather than binding a stable full-task identifier at the data seam.
independentReviewFinding.invariant: Each of the 648 index rows binds to exactly one source trace by cell-local position and a stable full-task identifier; every source trace is reachable once, and any row/source metadata mismatch fails loudly before display.
independentReviewFinding.allowedRepair: Add one small trace-identity helper, switch open_ to exact bound resolution, and add an exhaustive 648-row positive check plus collision and mismatch negative controls.
